Fit the outcome models for an estimand

Source: R/fit.R
pollin_fit.Rd

Fits one generalised linear mixed model per response in the estimand's data, with the pollination treatment as the fixed effect and the random terms of the design: response ~ treatment + <design random terms>. With by, the fixed part is treatment * by, so the treatment effect has its own fixed estimate at each level of by. The treatment is releveled so the estimand's low arm is the reference level. Every treatment level in the data is kept in the fit; the contrast is read from the fitted model by pollin_effects().

Usage

pollin_fit(estimand, engine = "glmmTMB", family = NULL, by = NULL, ...)

Arguments

estimand

A pollin_estimand() object.

engine

The fitting engine. Only "glmmTMB" is available; "flexyBayes" arrives in version 0.2.0.

family

NULL (the default) chooses a family per response from its values (count, proportion in (0, 1), positive continuous, or continuous with zeros). A single glmmTMB family object applies to every response; a named list gives one per response, and responses it does not name are chosen from their values.

by

Optional name of a column of the data (for example variety or region). The treatment effect is fitted separately at each of its levels, as an interaction, and pollin_effects() then reports one contrast per level. The column is treated as a factor.

...

Passed to glmmTMB::glmmTMB().

Value

An object of class pollin_fit: a list holding the estimand, the engine, the fitted models fits (named by response), the model data for each response, the right-hand-side terms rhs, the families, the by column (or NULL), and the further fitting arguments args.

Details

Rows with a missing value in the response, the treatment, a unit column or the by column are dropped for that response's model.

See also

pollin_effects() for estimates and intervals on the estimand's scale.

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(
  trt = rep(rep(c("Cage", "Open"), each = 10L), 8L),
  Site = rep(paste0("s", seq_len(8L)), each = 20L)
)
d$pods <- rnbinom(nrow(d), mu = exp(3 + 0.3 * (d$trt == "Open")), size = 10)
pd <- pollin_data(d, "pods", "trt", unit = "Site")
ds <- pollin_design(pd, c(excluded = "Cage", open = "Open"), "rcbd")
est <- pollin_estimand(ds, "dependence", "ratio", "loss")
pollin_fit(est)
#> <pollin_fit>
#>   engine    : glmmTMB 
#>   family    : dependence 
#>   contrast  : Open vs Cage 
#>   model     : <response> ~ trt + (1 | Site) 
#>   pods      : nbinom2, 160 rows
# }
